# download { #labdata.remote.download }

```python
labdata.remote.download(entry, blob_sha, lfs_oid, size, dest, client=None)
```

Stream one file's content from GitHub into a local path.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**entry**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Entry](`labdata.model.Entry`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Entry naming the repository.

<code>[**blob_sha**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Blob sha of the content, used for an ordinary file.

<code>[**lfs_oid**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Git LFS object id, used instead when the file is held in LFS.

<code>[**size**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Size of the real content, which the LFS batch endpoint asks for.

<code>[**dest**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   File to write.

<code>[**client**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Client](`labdata.github.Client`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Client to read with. Defaults to a new one.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[GitHubError](`labdata.github.GitHubError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the content cannot be read.
